change.summary: 组件库只修改了现有组件的样式,没有新增部件:DataTable 的 tone 标红后再加粗;ProgressList(compact)标签列改成 74px,条从网格列线起;FigureStrip 统一截图行高,FigureImage 不再自带固定高度;FigureGrid 让图铺满列宽。页面写法一般不用变。用法见 components.md;先截图看页面在新组件下是否正常,没有问题就不用改页面。

summary:
I ran the checker with the new component library and inspected the fresh screenshots (whole page plus the tiles covering the simulation grid, KPI row, tables, and the compact progress list).

Findings under the changed components:

- **FigureGrid / FigureImage**: the four screens (原界面 + 三类色盲) still fill the 9-column width, two per row, right edges aligned on the content edge, no cropping — the new "fill column width, no self height" behavior renders exactly as intended, no code change needed.
- **DataTable `tone`**: "不通过" cells now show bold + red, so the status carries a channel beyond color — the existing `tone: ["不通过"]` column already gives the right result.
- **ProgressList (compact)**: labels ("红色盲"…") sit in the 74px label column with the thin bars starting on the grid line and values right-aligned — fine as written.
- Program checks (build, component library, uniform scale, data fidelity, element bounds) all pass, so nothing in the page is affected in a way that needs editing.

No part of the page bypasses the component library, so no edit was required; Page.tsx is unchanged.

Page structure: 页头(地图导航 · 实时路况图层 / 2026-08-30 + 标题)→ 结论(结论句 + KV 口径)→ 色觉模拟(四张对照图)→ 核心指标(问题总数排第一,四个 `size="lg"` `Stat` 一行)→ 色板与对比度(配色表 + 对比度表,"不通过"标红加粗)→ 颜色混淆(四系列柱状图 + ΔE 明细表 + 受影响问题数 compact `ProgressList`)→ 问题清单(带严重度标记的 ordered `List`)。没有缺失的组件。
